body.contents:
Greetings!

Today we have a REALLY fun update!
Do you ever wish you could show off some style on the server?
Here's the solution: MAKE A NEW SKIN
Here's my solution: CUSTOM ARMOR TEXTURES!

Now, now, before you get TOO excited let me clear up some things:

1. These upgrades are PURLEY cosmetic, all they do is change the texture of your armor.
2. These upgrades can be applied to ANY ARMOR (In the base game)
3. Trims are compatible with all these armors
4. Cosmetics will be earned through: GAMBLING (As per your request)

If you head to spawn you'll see a Vault, if you use the new keys you can get from the shop ON said Vault then (currently) you can get 1 of 3 cosmetic upgrades. How do you get these upgrades ON your armor? Use the smithing table and any put it and your armor on it. THATS IT! YAY. Not like I had to make... 84 new json files for this update...

--Reminders--
When you "break" a spawner the item summons 1 block on TOP of the original, so don't put your spawners on ceilings!

---Known Bugs---
Dragon Egg doesn't work

---Fixed Bugs---
None

Can't wait to see what you think!
-Toadec
